notes: This is a fast wash, a preview of the official one (coarser surfaces, fewer droplets). Measured on this programme with anchored-v8.owner-capsule (the careful standard load, level seeds 1 and 2, simulation seeds 1 to 4), its verdict on a soiled item differs from the official wash in 9 of 100 cases: 0 in 100 for crockery, 21 in 100 for cutlery, 0 in 100 for glass, 0 in 100 for melamine. Scores are counted on the official wash.
knife_01 is at the edge of clean: what is left on it is seen by a sharp eye and not by a lenient one. The verdict given is that of the standard inspector.
